data.body:
REVERT executed (pre-approved Option A). The one-line pipefail fix was necessary but NOT sufficient: with the recipe made POSIX-portable, scanner-integration still fails at the actual contract step (pytest SCANNER_INTEGRATION_NODES) on every change — confirmed on two completed Verified runs of the fix commit (6b034b9f8224, now origin/main tip). Root cause of the incident: aa9e (6125c534) merged via a VACUOUS Verified vote — the newly-added required job never executed on its own introducing change, so its native-scanner contracts were never validated in CI.

Action: reverted BOTH 6125c534 (scanner integration) and 6b034b9f8224 (the now-moot one-liner), preserving 2600 (668523feffde, the 9a17 e2e fix). Pushed as Gerrit change 2616 "Revert scanner-integration Verified gate".

Local validation (worktree rebar-revert @ origin/main): make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (754 files), 99 targeted tests PASS (workflow_names, gerrit_verify_triage, gen_config_reference, mechanism_delta), no dangling refs to removed scanner modules, e2e-deps target (2600) intact.

{"run_id":"33844851231+33844839533","status":"failed","failure_type":"build-failure","failure_details":"scanner-integration required job fails at contract step on origin/main even after the pipefail portability fix; job introduced by 6125c534 was never validated (vacuous Verified vote). Blocks Verified +1 for all open changes.","fixes_applied":["revert 6125c534 + 6b034b9f8224 (scanner-integration Verified gate) as Gerrit 2616, preserving 2600"],"retry_count":0}

2612 (the one-liner) parked WIP — superseded by this revert. Next: 2616 must reach Verified +1 and land to restore a green gate for everyone. Not closing 90c7 until 2616 lands.
